missing_features.notes: Opt-in sticky unkeyed batching partitioner is not implemented; tracked in KL05-10.
Compression ID 4 decoding is unsupported in src/protocol/records.rs. Explicit missing feature of complete codec profile (KL05-02, KL05-03).
Zstd encoding is not implemented; deny.toml bans zstd-sys. Explicit missing feature of complete codec profile (KL05-02, KL05-04).
Proactive token refresh before expiry and broker session_lifetime_ms reauth are missing; tracked in KL06-01 to KL06-04.
Kerberos GSSAPI authentication is not implemented (requires Cyrus SASL C library). Explicit missing feature of enterprise auth profile (KL06-08 to KL06-10).
Opt-in Avro serialization/deserialization adapter; companion crate, tracked in KL05-25.
JSON Schema validation and serialization adapter; companion crate, tracked in KL05-27.

partial_features.notes: Caps queued key+value bytes; partial because headers, metadata, encoded buffers, and socket memory are uncounted (audit A08).
Partial because heartbeat loop uses fixed 150ms interval rather than broker response interval (audit A07, KL03-12).
